name: AiMark
description:
The Assistant brand mark. It leads assistant messages, the drawer header, the docked pane
and the landing hero. A brand mark, not an icon (R19.3): the product's configured `ai`
mark (src/ui/brand), drawn inline in the brand tones, so it follows the palette and stays
legible in dark mode.
signature: ({ size, working, label, className, ...rest }: AiMarkProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Omit when a nearby label already names the assistant.

props.name: size
props.description: xs 16 inline · sm 24 messages · md 32 headers · lg 64 the landing hero.

props.name: working
props.description: Draw the working ring (a spinner, so it is the one loop allowed, R18.2).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
